section.content: The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and electrolyte, wherein the positive plate comprises a positive forming body and a ceramic layer coated on the outer surface of the positive forming body, and the outer surface of the ceramic layer is also coated with a polymer layer; the negative plate comprises a negative forming body and a ceramic layer coated on the outer surface of the negative forming body, and the outer surface of the ceramic layer is further coated with a polymer layer; the positive electrode forming body and the negative electrode forming body are internally provided with metal nets respectively, and one end of each metal net is provided with a conductive lug extending out of the side edge of the positive electrode forming body or the negative electrode forming body; the positive plates and the negative plates are alternately stacked, and the electrolyte permeates into the pole pieces and is filled between the pole pieces. The utility model has the characteristics of simple structure, it is convenient to make.

本实用新型公开一种锂离子电池，包括正极片、负极片和电解液，所述正极片包括正极成型体，还包括包覆在正极成型体外表面的陶瓷层，所述陶瓷层外表面还包覆有一层高分子聚合物层；所述负极片包括负极成型体，还包括包覆在负极成型体外表面的陶瓷层，所述陶瓷层外表面还包覆有一层高分子聚合物层；所述正极成型体和负极成型体内分别设置有金属网，所述金属网的一端形成有伸出于所述正极成型体或负极成型体的侧边之外的导电极耳；所述正极片和负极片交替叠加设置，所述电解液渗透在极片中和填充在极片之间。本实用新型具有结构简单，制造方便的特点。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery field, concretely relates to lithium ion battery.

Background

The traditional lithium ion battery adopts a mode of coating after solvent dissolving and mixing to coat a positive/negative electrode material on a metal foil to form a positive/negative electrode material layer (the positive/negative electrode material generally comprises a positive/negative electrode active substance, a binder and a conductive agent), and the pole piece is prepared through processes of slitting, flaking and the like.

In view of the above, the applicant has made an intensive study on the above-mentioned defects in the prior art, and has made this invention.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

A primary object of the present invention is to provide a lithium ion battery having simple structure and convenient manufacturing.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the solution of the present invention is:

a lithium ion battery comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and electrolyte, wherein the positive plate comprises a positive forming body and a ceramic layer coated on the outer surface of the positive forming body, and the outer surface of the ceramic layer is further coated with a high polymer layer; the positive electrode forming body comprises a positive electrode material layer and a metal net arranged in the positive electrode material layer;

the negative plate comprises a negative forming body and a ceramic layer coated on the outer surface of the negative forming body, and the outer surface of the ceramic layer is further coated with a polymer layer; the negative electrode forming body comprises a negative electrode material layer and a metal net arranged in the negative electrode material layer;

conductive tabs extending out of the side edges of the positive electrode forming body or the negative electrode forming body are formed at one ends of the metal nets in the positive electrode forming body and the negative electrode forming body; the positive plates and the negative plates are alternately stacked, and the electrolyte permeates into the pole pieces and is filled between the pole pieces.

Further, the thickness of the ceramic layer is 5-60 μm.

Further, the thickness of the high polymer layer is 3 to 30 μm.

Furthermore, the mesh number of the metal net is 80-1200 meshes.

Further, the metal mesh comprises an aluminum mesh, a nickel mesh, a copper mesh or a stainless steel mesh.

After the structure is adopted, the utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, it has following beneficial effect at least:

the metal net is positioned in the positive electrode forming body and the negative electrode forming body and is connected with an external lead through a conductive tab connected with the metal net.

The high-molecular polymer layers on the positive plate and the negative plate bond the positive plate and the negative plate together, and the ceramic layers are arranged on the positive plate and the negative plate, so that the effect of isolating electrons is achieved, short circuit between the positive plate and the negative plate is prevented, and lithium ions can pass through the ceramic layers to migrate between the positive plate and the negative plate.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic perspective view of a lithium ion battery.

Fig. 2 is a schematic sectional structure view of the positive electrode sheet.

Fig. 3 is a schematic cross-sectional view of the negative electrode sheet.

Fig. 4 is a schematic structural view of the positive electrode sheet.

Fig. 5 is a schematic structural view of the negative electrode sheet.

In the figure:

a positive plate 1; a positive electrode molded body 11; a positive electrode material layer 111; a negative plate 2; a negative electrode molded body 21; a negative electrode material layer 211; a metal mesh 3; conductive tabs 31; a ceramic layer 4; a polymer layer 5.

Detailed Description

In order to further explain the technical solution of the present invention, the present invention is explained in detail by the following embodiments.

As shown in fig. 1 to 5, a lithium ion battery comprises a positive plate 1, a negative plate 2 and an electrolyte, wherein the positive plate 1 comprises a positive electrode forming body 11, and further comprises a ceramic layer 4 coated on the outer surface of the positive electrode forming body 11 and having a thickness of 5-60 μm, and a polymer layer 5 coated on the outer surface of the ceramic layer 4 and having a thickness of 3-30 μm; the positive electrode forming body 11 includes a positive electrode material layer 111 and a metal mesh 3 disposed in the positive electrode material layer 111.

The negative plate 2 comprises a negative forming body 21 and a ceramic layer 4 which is coated on the outer surface of the negative forming body 21 and has the thickness of 5-60 mu m, and a polymer layer 5 with the thickness of 3-30 mu m is coated on the outer surface of the ceramic layer 4; the negative electrode forming body 21 includes a negative electrode material layer 211 and a metal mesh 3 provided in the negative electrode material layer 211.

Conductive tabs 31 extending out of the side edges of the positive electrode forming body 11 or the negative electrode forming body 21 are formed at one end of the metal mesh 3 in the positive electrode forming body 11 and the negative electrode forming body 21; the positive plates 1 and the negative plates 2 are alternately stacked, and the electrolyte permeates into the pole pieces and is filled between the pole pieces.

Preferably, the mesh number of the metal net 3 is 80-1200 meshes. Further, the metal mesh 3 includes an aluminum mesh, a nickel mesh, a copper mesh, or a stainless steel mesh.

In this way, the metal mesh 3 is positioned in the positive electrode forming body 11 and the negative electrode forming body 21 and is connected with an external lead through a conductive tab 31 connected with the metal mesh 3; the polymer layer 5 on the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2 bonds the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2 together, the ceramic layer 4 is arranged on the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2, the function of isolating electrons is achieved, short circuit between the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2 is prevented, and lithium ions can pass through the ceramic layer 4 to migrate between the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2. The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery has simple structure, makes convenient characteristics.

Preferably, the mesh number of the metal net 3 is 80-1200 meshes; the metal net 3 comprises an aluminum net, a nickel net, a copper net or a stainless steel net.

① A method for manufacturing a positive plate 1 and a negative plate 2 respectively comprises the steps of mixing and stirring a binder, a conductive agent powder and a positive active material or a negative active material powder uniformly, heating to 80-200 ℃, putting into a prefabricated mold with a built-in metal mesh 3, applying a pressure of 3-20MPa to the powder in the mold, molding to obtain a positive molding 11 and a negative molding 21 respectively, wherein the metal mesh 3 is formed in the positive molding 11 and the negative molding 21 respectively, a conductive tab 31 extending out of the side edge of the positive molding 11 or the negative molding 21 is formed at one end of the metal mesh 3, immersing the positive molding 11 and the negative molding 21 into a ceramic solution, drying, coating the surface of the positive molding 11 and the surface of the negative molding 21 with a ceramic layer 4, the thickness of the ceramic layer 4 is 5-60 mu m, immersing the positive molding 11 and the negative molding 21 into a polymer solution, drying, and forming a polymer layer 5 on the surface of the positive molding 11 and the negative molding 21 to obtain a polymer layer 1, a negative plate 2, and preferably 30-3 mu m of the polymer layer.

②, alternately stacking the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2, fixing, heating, baking, immersing in electrolyte in anhydrous environment, and forming with 0.01-0.2C current to obtain semi-finished product.

③ heating the semi-finished product to 60-100 deg.C, placing in a prefabricated mould, applying 0.2-15MPa pressure to form it, placing in a casing, and packaging to obtain the final product.

Preferably, the positive electrode active material includes one or more of lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium nickel cobalt manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium titanate or lithium nickel cobalt aluminate.

Preferably, the negative active material includes one or more of graphite, mesocarbon microbeads, hard carbon, soft carbon, lithium titanate, or silicon carbon.

Preferably, the binder comprises PVDF, PTFE, acrylate or styrene butadiene rubber. The positive electrode active material or the negative electrode active material is bonded to the conductive agent by the bonding action of the binder.

Preferably, the conductive agent comprises carbon black, CNT, graphite, graphene or metal wire.

Thus, the mixed powder is heated to 80 to 200 ℃ before being placed in a prefabricated mold to soften the binder in the powder, thereby binding the active material and the conductive agent together, and then pressed by the mold to form the sheet-shaped positive electrode molding 11 or negative electrode molding 21.

In the heating and pressurizing process of step ③, the polymer layer 5 on the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2 bonds the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2 together, and the ceramic layers 4 are arranged on the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2 to isolate electrons, so as to prevent short circuit between the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2, and lithium ions can pass through the ceramic layers 4 to migrate between the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2.

When the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged, the metal mesh 3 is positioned in the positive electrode forming body 11 and the negative electrode forming body 21 and is connected with an external lead through a conductive tab 31 connected with the metal mesh 3.

In step ③, the viscosity of the electrolyte can be reduced by heating the formed battery semi-finished product to 60-100 ℃, so as to accelerate the permeation rate of the electrolyte, so that the electrolyte can permeate into the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2, and the generated gas can be discharged out of the surface of the pole piece by applying pressure of 0.2-15MPa in step ③, so as to prevent the effect of the battery from being influenced by the formation of dead lithium on the surface of the pole piece.

The above embodiments and drawings are not intended to limit the form and style of the present invention, and any suitable changes or modifications made by those skilled in the art should not be construed as departing from the scope of the present invention.
